Workout Volume Calculator

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Increase volume gradually (≤10%/week).

📖 How to use

  1. Press Add exercise for each lift in your session.
  2. Enter name, sets, reps, and weight in kg.
  3. Watch per-exercise volume and each share of the total.
  4. Use the session total to track progressive overload.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is training volume?

Sets × reps × weight (kg). It measures total work done, a key driver of muscle and strength progress.

What is per-exercise share?

Volume per exercise ÷ total session volume, shown as a percentage so you can see where your work went.

Is more volume always better?

Higher is not always better — volume should rise gradually; jumps over ~10% per week raise injury risk.
